about_the_game:
Math MunCheese is a math tutor and memorization game.

The player controls a mouse, and attempts to answer mathematics questions whilst avoiding cats. As the game goes on, the questions become more difficult, and the cats become harder to avoid.

Math MunCheese teaches and drills addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, multiples, factors and primes. Other features include animated math explainers, cutscenes, and a high scores screen.

Math MunCheese is available on Steam for x86_64 (standard Intel and AMD processors) Windows and Linux computers, as well as ARM (Apple Silicon) Macs.
